All five `utcnow()` calls sites are now `datetime.now(timezone.utc)`, in `audit.py`, `billing.py`, `cache.py`, `reports.py` and `sessions.py`. Each file also imports `timezone`. The 5 tests pass with `-W error::DeprecationWarning`, and grep finds no `utcnow` left in `app/` or `tests/`.

Datetimes returned by these modules are now timezone-aware instead of naive. `reports.header()` also now prints a `+00:00` suffix, for example `T generated 2026-10-17T20:08:00+00:00`. Only the `startswith` check in the test covers it, so it passes. Anything outside this repo that parses that header string, or compares these values against naive datetimes, will need updating. Mixing aware and naive datetimes raises `TypeError`.
